en: Welcome aboard the S.S. Aqua. ...Forgive me, I'm distracted. My granddaughter has slipped away somewhere on the ship again.
She loves to hide. Would you look for her? Try the cabins first.
There she is, safe and sound! Thank you. A captain's thanks isn't much, so please take this as well.
Welcome to the bridge! The S.S. Aqua is the fastest ship on these waters. We'll get you where you're going.
